name: GameN Room A and Room B: fixed personal views with one blind place

status.design_selection: Selected by the owner in this conversation for the initial visual prototype.
status.selection_basis: The owner accepted the perimeter proposal and then accepted retaining three visible others at full occupancy.

purpose: Give each player a personal view from a stable room place, retain enough visible people for discussion, and create one consistent asymmetric blind place when all five places are occupied.

scope.place_ids_are: Local geometric place IDs, not human player identities, selected character names, hidden roles, factions, or room names.
scope.other_rooms: Command Room, Hospital, Jail, Supply Room and Private Room require their own camera layouts; this file does not assign five places to them.
scope.other_game_rules: Existing movement, targeting, room capacity, reserved station access, timing and private-information rules remain outside this geometric specification.

selected_design.view_mode: One personal, fixed viewpoint for each occupied place.
selected_design.full_room_visibility: At five occupants, each sees three of the other four and is inside the view cone of exactly three others.
selected_design.field_of_view_axis: Horizontal angle in the floor-plan model.
selected_design.two_person_policy: Keep the two players in their actual places. One-way sight is allowed; mutual sight is not guaranteed for every pair.
selected_design.empty_or_solitary_room_policy: Render the empty room or a solitary player normally. Do not create, move or reveal another player to fill the view.
selected_design.self_visibility_in_graph: A viewer is excluded from their own sees list. Whether first-person hands or a shoulder appear is a visual composition detail.

coordinate_system.angle_rotation: clockwise because screen Y increases downward

layout.layout_description: A and E are near the north wall, B near the south wall, C near the east wall, and D near the west wall. The centre remains clear.
layout.scaling: Uniform scaling and translation preserve the angular relationships. Non-uniform scaling, moving a place or changing a direction requires recalculation.
layout.camera_geometry_model: The angular calculation places the camera at the place anchor. Actual camera height, pitch, shoulder offset and character dimensions are not included.
layout.walls: The square boundary limits the room. All inter-place centre segments in this layout remain within it.

visibility_definition.visible: The subject anchor centre lies inside the viewer horizontal angular cone.
visibility_definition.sees: Other occupied place IDs whose centres lie inside this viewer cone.
visibility_definition.seen_by: Other occupied place IDs whose cones contain this subject centre.
visibility_definition.not_an_action_witness_count: These counts do not prove a player can see a hand, tool, face, target, action execution or outcome.
visibility_definition.furniture_and_body_occlusion: Not represented in this point model.
visibility_definition.orientation_check: Rear-view analysis compares the viewer position with the subject baseline body direction. It does not validate every animated pose.
visibility_definition.unknown_occupied_places: The model requires the authorized occupied-place list for the current room/view. It does not infer hidden or unavailable state.

calculation_algorithm.input: A viewer place ID and a set of occupied local place IDs drawn from A,B,C,D,E.
calculation_algorithm.bearing: bearing_deg = (atan2(subject.y - viewer.y, subject.x - viewer.x) * 180 / pi + 360) mod 360
calculation_algorithm.edge_inclusion: Inclusive for centre-point geometry. An on-edge centre does not imply that the full body fits.
calculation_algorithm.occupancy_filter: Remove empty places from sees and seen_by; do not recompute place directions or invent replacement occupants.
calculation_algorithm.recompute_triggers: Authorized occupancy changes or a permitted player move to a different place.
calculation_algorithm.cache: The full five-place geometric adjacency can be precomputed. Runtime occupancy selects a subgraph.
calculation_algorithm.language_note: mod means mathematical nonnegative modulo; normalize negative remainders when required by the implementation language.

full_room_visibility.blind_cycle_meaning: Each place in the sequence cannot see the next place. The next place can see it.

two_person_relationships.no_AB_only_assignment: A and B are one mutually visible pair, not mandatory destinations whenever only two players remain.

transition_example.reason: C departed. A and D keep their places and original view directions.

state_and_rendering_integration.binding: Bind a current authorized occupant identity to a local place. The place geometry does not depend on character, role or faction.

runtime_slot_mapping.status: To be mapped explicitly during integration
runtime_slot_mapping.constraint: Map semantic stations and preserve their functions; do not assume alphabetic place IDs in this diagram are interchangeable with existing station IDs.

state_and_rendering_integration.movement: Follow accepted game movement only. A departing player leaves an empty place; other occupants are not reseated or recentered.
state_and_rendering_integration.blackout: The geometric graph does not override Blackout concealment. Keep the approved framing/target freeze and existing visibility behavior.
state_and_rendering_integration.parallel_realities: Use only the room state authorized for that viewer/current reality. Do not combine occupancies from different realities.
state_and_rendering_integration.private_actions: Being geometrically visible does not authorize revealing a secret action, role, private result, dialogue or Promise.
state_and_rendering_integration.targeting: This file does not change legal targets or action range. A hidden on-screen character is not automatically an ineligible target.

board_and_shared_display.question_to_resolve: Whether the personal blind place limits only the room image or also access to observable action details in Board/shared-display presentations.
board_and_shared_display.constraint: Do not claim that this room geometry alone prevents a player learning the same event through another authorized surface.

visual_handoff.occupancy_does_not_require_new_room_art: The same place view is reused while independently rendered occupants enter or leave.
visual_handoff.workstations: Use low or angled inward-facing workstations and keep the centre open. Preserve important face, hand, tool and target visibility.
visual_handoff.character_art: Use separate character rigs/art and the specified baseline directions. Side/three-quarter art and individual pose adjustments may still be needed.
visual_handoff.no_baked_occupants_or_information: Do not paint occupants, names, numbers, role data or changing screen text into room backgrounds.
visual_handoff.room_layers: Compose static room architecture, movable prop parts, characters and local foreground occluders separately.
visual_handoff.exterior_windows: Views outside the ship remain independent animated Far scenes within window masks; this file does not add exterior windows.
visual_handoff.visual_finish: Follow the shared comic-noir finishing approach, preserving readability and semantic UI/team/status colours.
visual_handoff.labels_and_inputs: Keep name labels away from faces and ensure permitted interactions remain usable in every view.
visual_handoff.rendering_clearance: The angular centre margin is not a full-body clearance guarantee. Check actual rigs, tools, furniture and camera offsets.
visual_handoff.reduced_motion: Reduce decorative movement without changing geometric visibility or permitted game interactions.

responsibilities.Claude_Designer: Build the approved visual components, room views, art, rigs, motion and specifically assigned game-side connections from the canonical source.
responsibilities.Frontend: Review and connect authorized state, commands, lifecycle, accessibility and performance; reuse the canonical visual components.
responsibilities.Backend: Retain authority over game state, permissions, outcomes, timing and disclosure.
responsibilities.Integration: Coordinate slot mapping, compatible versions, technical review and any separately authorized release.

calculation_evidence.method: Direct angle calculations from the serialized six-decimal coordinates and three-decimal directions, plus enumeration of all occupied subsets.
calculation_evidence.verification_scope: Offline geometry and JSON consistency only; not a game test, phone render review or balance playtest.

remaining_design_work.detail: Render all five personal views using the actual characters, labels, hands, props and room geometry.
Specify camera height, pitch, eye/shoulder offset and silhouette dimensions; retain the intended three-visible/one-blind relationships.
Map local places to existing room station IDs without changing reserved window/device access or movement rules.

remaining_design_work.status: Not decided by this geometry handoff
remaining_design_work.detail: Resolve Room, Board and shared-display observation behavior before treating blind places as an information restriction.
Evaluate the selected three-of-four design before considering a reduction to two visible others.
